name: easy-floorplan-card
description: Interactive floorplan card for Home Assistant with a visual editor for walls, doors, windows, furniture, text and device/light controls

scripts.ha: npm run build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up
scripts.ha:reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && rm -rf docker/config/.storage docker/config/home-assistant_v2.db* docker/config/home-assistant.log*

author: Nicolas Sandller
